performance.status: Deferred prototype; not the retained release UI
performance.scope: Five alternating clean pairs per selection state, same 2000-anchor fixture; click to modal removal plus two animation callbacks, not physical presentation or complete editor latency acceptance
performance.excludedInitialStudy: Port 5317 was occupied by an older build; the initial pair timings are invalid and retained only as failed diagnostic evidence. Final control uses an OS-allocated server with every served resource verified.

verification.earlierFindings: The footer-isolation prototype showed no reliable benefit under the valid five-pair Vite comparison and more cold-case long tasks, so its source is retained only in evidence and the original App restored. Retain the original 10-pass/2-failure native pilot: one harness deadlock awaited closure before releasing its save; one genuine denied IndexedDB getter aborted optional recent initialization. The next native 33-case pilot passed but production synchronous quota injection exposed an uncaught IndexedDB request callback and lost cause. Two new native rollback cases passed; a test annotation prevented bundling, so the queued stale-release production probe is excluded. After correcting the annotation, rebuilt native rollback and production retry/reopen acceptance passed. The restricted canonical run denied spawn/listen (4 failed, 82 skipped); the approved complete suite is the accepted gate.

limits: Local headless Chromium scheduling and three pairs do not establish physical-display latency or sustained/all-tool performance
Dense Boolean frame gaps and observed long tasks remain explicit unresolved F14 requirements
Status isolation changes no artwork, public OO mutation contract, persistent schema, provider/account/upload or script/plugin/REST privilege
Notification loss may require explicit list reload; generation guards do not imply live filesystem synchronization

All other unfinished original professional, photo/color/interchange, AI/provider/evaluation/production, workflow/collaboration/commercial/specialist and device/process-memory requirements remain active
